{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "docs",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches only a release note (doc/release-notes-private-broadcast-wait.md), which merely follows the code change.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Release note additions that follow a functional change belong to the area being changed, not docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the 'Private Broadcast' label and modifies node broadcast semantics and functional tests for private transaction broadcast.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "External wallets calling sendrawtransaction for private broadcasts fail because the call 'skips inserting the transaction into the mempool and returns immediately,' violating caller expectations that the transaction is in the mempool upon return. Synchronous acceptance waiting also provides leverage by resolving deadlock risks that block private broadcast wallet support."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Modifications in src/rpc/mempool.cpp only expose the underlying broadcast timeout parameter on sendrawtransaction without altering RPC framework mechanics.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The PR alters private broadcast behavior and only exposes the option via an RPC parameter; the behavior an RPC merely exposes belongs to that area, not RPC."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Functional tests and validation interface test additions pin private broadcast and callback behavior rather than framework infrastructure.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Tests that exercise private broadcast and validation interface behavior belong to those areas rather than general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Minor changes to src/common/messages.cpp are incidental to the broadcast changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Incidental error string changes across shared utilities do not constitute a core utilities change."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validationinterface.h and src/validationinterface.cpp to add a synchronous callback, but does not alter validation rules, chainstate, or consensus code.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Adding a synchronous event hook to CValidationInterface facilitates caller coordination without modifying validation invariants or chainstate logic."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 1,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 0,
    "user_value": 2,
    "leverage": 2
  }
}
